title: mris_preproc
description: Script to prepare surface-based data for high-level analysis by resampling surface or volume source data to a common subject and concatenating them into one file.

target_subject.description: Subject to use as the common-space. All input data will be resampled to the surface of this subject.
target_subject.title: Target Subject

hemi.description: Use hemisphere for source and target surfaces. Can be lh or rh.
hemi.title: Hemisphere

meas.description: Use subject/surf/hemi.surfmeasure as input. Implies --srcfmt curv.
meas.title: Surface Measure

label.description: Look in label/hemi.annotname.(annot,mgz) and use mapmethod nnf.
label.title: Label

measdir.description: Look in subdir instead of surf.
measdir.title: Measure Directory

subjects.description: Specify an input subject on the command-line. All subjects must be specified in this way.
subjects.title: Subjects

fsgd.description: Specify the list of input subjects from the fsgd file.
fsgd.title: FSGD File

subjectlist.description: List all subjects separated by white space in subjlistfile.
subjectlist.title: Subject List File

qdec.description: Specify list of subjects via qdec table file. Assumes the first column is the "fsid".
qdec.title: QDEC Table

qdec_long.description: Specify list of subjects via longitudinal qdec table file.
qdec_long.title: QDEC Longitudinal Table

surfmeasfile.description: Specify full path to input surface measure file.
surfmeasfile.title: Surface Measure File

volmeasfile_reg.description: Specify full path to a volume file and its registration matrix file.
volmeasfile_reg.title: Volume Measure and Registration Files

projfrac.description: When sampling a volume onto the surface, sample a fraction of the thickness along the surface normal.
projfrac.title: Projection Fraction

projfrac_max.description: When sampling a volume onto the surface, find max along projection for vol2surf.
projfrac_max.title: Projection Fraction Max

projfrac_avg.description: Compute average along projection for vol2surf.
projfrac_avg.title: Projection Fraction Average

no_mask_non_cortex.description: Do not mask out non-cortex in vol2surf.
no_mask_non_cortex.title: No Mask Non-Cortex Flag

etiv_flag.description: Divide each subject's value by the Estimated Total Intra Cranial Volume as found in aseg.stats.
etiv_flag.title: ETIV Flag

fwhm.description: Smooth by fwhm mm on the target surface.
fwhm.title: FWHM Smoothing

fwhm_src.description: Smooth by fwhm mm on the source surface.
fwhm_src.title: FWHM Source Smoothing

niters.description: Smooth by niters on the target surface.
niters.title: Number of Iterations Smoothing

niters_src.description: Smooth by niters on the source surface.
niters_src.title: Source Smoothing Iterations

paired_diff_flag.description: Compute paired differences after concatenating all inputs together.
paired_diff_flag.title: Paired Difference Flag

cache_out.description: Cache the output in the specified cache file.
cache_out.title: Cache Output

cache_in.description: Use the pre-computed cached data from the specified cache file.
cache_in.title: Cache Input

cache_out_only.description: Cache data without actually creating an output.
cache_out_only.title: Cache Output Only

mean_flag.description: Compute the mean of all inputs.
mean_flag.title: Mean Flag

std_flag.description: Compute the standard deviation of all inputs.
std_flag.title: Standard Deviation Flag

surfreg.description: Use specified surface registration to the common space.
surfreg.title: Surface Registration

synth_flag.description: Synthesize the input data with white gaussian noise.
synth_flag.title: Synthesize Flag

nolog_flag.description: Do not create a log file.
nolog_flag.title: No Log Flag
